description: Maps every BLS CPI Entry Level Item (ELI) reachable from the pinned UCC->ELI concordance onto exactly one candidate DMI computation node from detailed_inflation_taxonomy_v0_1.json.
resolution_algorithm: 1. Exact lookup of the full 5-character ELI in `eli_overrides`.
2. Otherwise exact lookup of the leading 2 characters of the ELI in `eli_prefix_to_node`.
3. Otherwise raise. There is no fallback, no fuzzy match, and no default node.
why_prefix_keys: The first two characters of a BLS ELI code are a structural component of the identifier that denotes the CPI item grouping (e.g. `TB` = motor fuel, `HF` = electricity and utility gas). Prefix lookup is therefore an exact join on a documented identifier substring, not a label heuristic. Every prefix below was verified to be node-homogeneous across all ELIs in the pinned concordance; the single heterogeneous prefix (`TA`) is handled by explicit overrides.
attribution: ELI codes and titles are published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. The assignment of ELIs to DMI computation nodes is DMI research metadata and is not a BLS product.

TA031.reason: CPI classifies leased cars and trucks as a transportation service, not a transportation commodity, even though the ELI shares the TA (new and used motor vehicles) prefix.

TA041.reason: CPI classifies car and truck rental as a transportation service, not a transportation commodity, even though the ELI shares the TA prefix.
